labeling.method: Developer-authored expected outcomes for a fictional regression fixture; revision 2 corrects audio segment offsets that revision 1 had mislabeled as event timestamps. No field accuracy claim.
labeling.citation_scope: The evidence arrays name canonical required references; duplicate and alternate-source references were not exhaustively adjudicated.

exercise.title: Night Shift: Extended Power Loss (fictional evaluation fixture)
exercise.scenario: Fictional regional hospital exercise: prolonged utility outage tests emergency power transfer, unit communications, timestamp accuracy, and patient-care continuity.

objectives.text: Restore and confirm essential power circuits within 60 seconds of a primary supply interruption.

evaluation_rule.finding_title: Essential power restoration exceeded the exercise target

objectives.text: Communicate outage status and obtain unit acknowledgement within three minutes.

start_terms: request for each inpatient unit to acknowledge
evaluation_rule.finding_title: Unit acknowledgement exceeded the three-minute objective

objectives.text: Activate patient-care continuity procedures and preserve medication cold-chain records.
Capture and reconcile response start and arrival timestamps in the incident log.

completion_terms: facilities technician arrived at the switch room
claim_terms: incident log recorded a facilities response time
evaluation_rule.finding_title: Reported response time conflicts with source timestamps

objectives.text: Record an accountable owner for each improvement action.

evaluation_rule.finding_title: Improvement action owner is not recorded

observations.wording: Primary utility power supply failed at the hospital.
Backup generator was stable and essential circuits were restored four minutes after the primary supply failed.
Outage acknowledgement was requested from the inpatient units by radio.
The ICU acknowledged the outage by runner; radio acknowledgement was not confirmed until seven minutes after the request.
Facilities technician arrived at the switch room six minutes after the primary supply failure.
Incident log recorded a facilities response time of two minutes.
Staff completed the emergency medication cold-chain relocation procedure and logged chain of custody.
Improvement action to reduce radio acknowledgement delays was recorded but the owner field was left blank.
Evaluator A: The primary utility power supply failed.
Evaluator A: Backup generator output and essential circuits were stable four minutes after the failure.
Evaluator B: Incident Command sent a radio request for each inpatient unit to acknowledge the outage.
Evaluator B: ICU acknowledgement came by runner; the radio acknowledgement was delayed seven minutes.
Evaluator A: Facilities technician arrived at the switch room six minutes after power failed.
Evaluator A: The incident log says the response time was two minutes, although the failure was logged at 09:02 and arrival at 09:08.
Evaluator C: ICU staff completed the emergency medication cold-chain relocation procedure and documented chain of custody.
Evaluator C: A follow-up action for radio acknowledgement delay was recorded, but no responsible owner was entered.
Evaluator B: My watch shows acknowledgement at 09:11, while the control room log says 09:10. The acknowledgement time is unresolved.
Generator lagged a bit before transfer, I guess. (No time or direct measurement recorded.)
Facilities arrived at the switch room at nine oh eight.
The log says response time was too minutes.
ICU completed the cold-chain relocation procedure.
